note: Premature complete after incomplete library membership checks.

strategies.name: BLOCK_RISKY_ACTION
strategies.guidance: Do not call complete_task yet. Recompute library vs liked vs downloaded membership and remove remaining ineligible songs first.

strategies.name: VERIFY_TARGET_SET
strategies.guidance: Before complete_task, recompute membership for every library song against liked and downloaded sets. If any song is in neither, remove it. Do not claim nothing to remove without printing both checks.

strategies.name: REPLAN
strategies.guidance: Do not complete. Re-plan: list library, liked, downloaded -> compute remove_set = library - liked - downloaded -> remove remove_set -> re-list -> complete_task(answer=None).

strategies.name: LOOKUP_API_SPEC
strategies.guidance: Do not complete yet. Call show_api_doc for Spotify library/liked/downloaded/remove APIs, then finish membership cleanup before complete_task().
